title: Interpretable Predictability-Based AI Text Detection: A Replication Study
abstract: arXiv:2603.15034v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper replicates and extends the system used in the AuTexTification shared task for authorship attribution of machine-generated texts. Exact replication was not possible because of differences in data splits, model availability, and implementation details, which we document as a case study in reproducibility. We tested newer multilingual language models (mDeBERTa-v3-base, Qwen, mGPT) and added 26 document-level stylometric features, using ablation, permutation importance, and SHAP analysis to assess feature influence. A single shared configuration was applied to both English and Spanish across Subtask 1 and Subtask 2. Averaged over three random seeds, the shared multilingual configuration performs comparably to or better than the language-specific baseline, with the clearest gains on model attribution (Subtask 2). The additional stylometric features yield small improvements, led by lexical diversity, but their contribution

translated_title: 基于可预测性的可解释AI文本检测：一项复现研究
translated_abstract: 本文复现并扩展了AuTexTification共享任务中用于机器生成文本作者归属的系统。由于数据划分、模型可用性和实现细节方面的差异，无法进行精确复现，我们将其记录为一个可复现性的案例研究。我们测试了更新的多语言语言模型（mDeBERTa-v3-base、Qwen、mGPT），并添加了26个文档级文体特征，通过消融实验、置换重要性和SHAP分析来评估特征的影响力。同一套共享配置被同时应用于英语和西班牙语的子任务1和子任务2。在三个随机种子上的平均结果显示，共享多语言配置的性能与语言特定基线相当或更优，其中在模型归属任务（子任务2）上的提升最为明显。额外添加的文体特征带来了小幅改进，其中以词汇多样性的贡献最为突出，但其贡献
tldr: 该研究复现并扩展了AuTexTification机器生成文本作者归属系统，通过引入更新的多语言模型和26个文体特征，发现单一共享多语言配置在英语和西班牙语上均能达到与语言特定基线相当或更优的性能。
en_tdlr: This replication study extends the AuTexTification AI text attribution system with newer multilingual models and 26 stylometric features, showing that a single shared multilingual configuration performs comparably to or better than language-specific baselines across both English and Spanish.
